profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The University of Texas at Austin

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Responsible for management of enterprise-scale file server and email infrastructure implementations, including on-premise and cloud products by Microsoft, Cisco, and Google
-Design of automation tools built in PowerShell
-Consulting with other units within the organization to provide guidance on major infrastructure projects

positions.title: Deputy of Counter Intelligence
positions.description:
The DCI is responsible for the Geek Squad® team, and drives the financial and operational outcomes of the Precinct, district, territory, and overall organization.

This supervisory role includes assisting in the recruiting, development, direction and mentoring of Geek Squad Agents to optimize customer satisfaction and loyalty, while keeping the store humming and enhancing business performance.

positions.title: Computer Equipment Maintenance Technician
positions.description:
-Provide deskside support to faculty and staff of the University of Texas at Austin.
-Set up/configure computing and networking equipment including workstations, servers, and network attached storage.
-Procure computing and networking equipment essential to continuing operations.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

certifications.name: ITIL® Foundation Certificate in IT Service Management
certifications.title: ITIL® Foundation Certificate in IT Service Management

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Staff Council, The University of Texas at Austin
volunteerExperiences.description:

company.name: Staff Council, The University of Texas at Austin

volunteerExperiences.description: The C13 Information Technology Committee is tasked with making recommendations regarding changes to information technology policies and procedures to the President of the University and to the Chief Information Officer.

projects.title: Migration to Exchange Online
